title: Ollie's Place Cottage
description:
Welcome to Ollie's Place. Situated in the quaint historic town of Nolensville, our cottage is the perfect home base for exploring Nashville and surrounding areas. 
We are only 15 minutes from Arrington Vineyard and New Approach School for Jewelers, Arrington, TN.
30 minutes from downtown Nashville, Franklin and Murfreesboro. 

Our cottage is perfect for a couple. It has a kitchenette/dining/living area, bedroom with a queen size bed, flat screen TV with Wi-Fi.

The space
Large Bedroom with (1) Queen size bed, large closet w/ chest of drawers. Ceiling fan, TV with internet, (2) windows with view to back of property and trees. Kitchenette with dining & living area. Stocked with microwave, Keurig, 2 ring stove top, pots and frying pan, cooking utensils.  Dine in table with (2) chairs, 2 comfy chairs in the living area. 
There is covered parking for one vehicle - a second can be accommodated upon request.

Other things to note
Check-in at 3:00pm
Check-out by 11:00am
No smoking inside or outside the rental
No pets permitted inside or outside the rental
No children under 12 years of age
A maximum of two persons are allowed in the rental
We ask that you are considerate of our neighbors, and keep things on the quieter side after 9:00pm
